function [Result,Result_File] = solve_one_stage(~,CONF,paths,Return_No_Incumbent)
% SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Copied to a temporary MATLAB path only by the test.
assert(Return_No_Incumbent && isappdata(0,'joint_scan_test_state'));
State = getappdata(0,'joint_scan_test_state');
State.Calls = State.Calls+1;
setappdata(0,'joint_scan_test_state',State);
C = normalize_multiple_snapshot_conf(CONF);
Stage2 = strcmp(C.SolveStage,'optimality-proof');
Mode = string(State.Mode);
if Mode=="error" || (Mode=="stage2_error" && Stage2)
    error('JointScanTest:SyntheticFailure','Synthetic stage failure.');
end
Raw = 'OPTIMAL'; Problem = 0; Has = true; Gap = 0.004;
if any(Mode==["two_stage","stage2_error","above_gap","stage2_stop"]) && ~Stage2
    Raw = 'TIME_LIMIT'; Problem = 3; Gap = 0.1;
end
if Mode=="above_gap" && Stage2
    Raw = 'TIME_LIMIT'; Problem = 3; Gap = 0.05;
elseif Mode=="infeasible"
    Raw = 'INFEASIBLE'; Problem = 1; Has = false; Gap = NaN;
elseif Mode=="stop" || (Mode=="stage2_stop" && Stage2)
    Raw = 'TIME_LIMIT'; Problem = 3; Has = false; Gap = NaN;
elseif Mode=="ambiguous"
    Raw = 'INF_OR_UNBD'; Problem = 12; Has = false; Gap = NaN;
end
Cost = 1e6*(6-C.I_limit_kA_Node(1)+C.SCR_min);
if any(Mode==["gap_reversal","disjoint_bounds"])
    Cost = 1000;
    if C.I_limit_kA_Node(1)<5.7
        if Mode=="gap_reversal", Cost = 999; else, Cost = 900; end
    end
end
D = struct('has_incumbent',Has,'problem',Problem,'info','SYNTHETIC TEST ONLY', ...
    'solver_status',Raw,'objective',Cost,'best_bound',Cost*(1-Gap),'mip_gap',Gap);
if isfield(C,'MIPStart'), C = rmfield(C,'MIPStart'); end
Result = struct('CONF',C,'Diagnostics',D,'solve_time',0.01);
if Has
    Result.Cost = struct('Total',Cost,'CON',0.1*Cost,'GEN',0.7*Cost, ...
        'UC',0.1*Cost,'Curt',0.1*Cost);
    if Mode=="bad_cost", Result.Cost.Total = Cost+100; end
    Result.u_GFM_Mod = [1 0;1 1;0 0];
    Result.u_G = ones(C.Gn,C.TypicalDayCount,C.PeriodCount);
    Result.u_G_Start = zeros(size(Result.u_G));
    Result.u_G_Stop = zeros(size(Result.u_G));
    Result.u_G_SCC = ones(C.Gn,C.TypicalDayCount);
    Result.u_G_SCR = ones(C.Gn,C.TypicalDayCount);
    CS = [C.GFM_Candidate_Count,C.TypicalDayCount,C.WindScenarioCount,C.PeriodCount];
    NS = [C.Bn,C.TypicalDayCount,C.WindScenarioCount,C.PeriodCount];
    Result.u_GFM_Ch = zeros(CS);
    Result.P_G = zeros(C.Gn,C.TypicalDayCount,C.WindScenarioCount,C.PeriodCount);
    Result.P_GFL = zeros(NS); Result.P_GFL_Curt = zeros(NS);
    Result.P_GFM_Dis = zeros(CS); Result.P_GFM_Ch = zeros(CS); Result.E_GFM = zeros(CS);
    Result.SCC_1 = (C.I_limit_kA_Node(1)-0.1)*ones(C.Bn,C.TypicalDayCount);
    Result.SCR = (C.SCR_min+0.1)*ones(C.Bn,C.TypicalDayCount);
    Result.SCC_TimeResolved = (C.I_limit_kA_Node(1)-0.2)* ...
        ones(C.PeriodCount,C.TypicalDayCount,numel(C.SCC_Constraint_Original_Nodes));
    Result.SCR_TimeResolved = (C.SCR_min+0.2)* ...
        ones(C.PeriodCount,C.TypicalDayCount,numel(C.Safety_GFL_Original_Nodes));
    Result.SecurityValidation = struct('Passed',true, ...
        'SCC',struct('Tolerance',1e-6),'SCR',struct('Tolerance',1e-6));
end
ensure_directory(paths.results_dir);
Result_File = fullfile(paths.results_dir,'SYNTHETIC_ONLY.mat');
save(Result_File,'Result','-v7.3');
end
